title: Bride & Groom Dancing at Wedding Reception, 1950s B&W Photo
description: A black-and-white deckle-edged snapshot capturing a bride and groom dancing together during their wedding reception in the 1950s. Surrounding them are family members and guests dressed in mid-century formal attire, celebrating the occasion. In the background, a large stack of wrapped wedding gifts sits on a table in front of a painted backdrop featuring scenic snow-capped mountains.
